name: starflask_generate_3d
description: Create a Starflask 3D mesh generation job (text-to-3D or image-to-3D). Returns a job id immediately — poll with starflask_get_job until status is 'completed', then read result.model_url (the generated 3D model) and result.thumbnail_url. Provide a `prompt` for text-to-3D, or an `image_url` (from starflask_upload_media) for image-to-3D. Optional: `topology` (e.g. "triangle" or "quad"), `target_polycount` (integer), `enable_pbr` (boolean for PBR textures), and `model_key` (default meshy-v6). The job type is sent as "mesh" for you. Use starflask_list_models for available mesh models and params.

prompt.description: Text description of the 3D model to generate. Provide this or image_url.

image_url.description: Optional source image URL for image-to-3D (from starflask_upload_media). Provide this or prompt.

model_key.description: Optional mesh model key. Defaults to meshy-v6.

enable_pbr.description: Optional — generate PBR (physically based rendering) textures.
